labs.pi_title: Director, Rafik B. Hariri Institute for Computing and Computational Science & Engineering; Distinguished Professor of Engineering (ECE, SE, BME)
labs.research_summary: University-wide computing institute organizing centers, initiatives and faculty-fellow programs across BU; core/faculty-affiliate PIs' own labs are recorded under their home departments.
labs.join_notes: Faculty Affiliate Program, Focused Research Programs, Junior Faculty Fellows Program, Graduate Student Fellows Program, Data Science Mentoring Circles, and BU-AIRR are all open application-based ways to join/engage with the Institute.
labs.notes: Cross-cutting university-wide hub, not a department of its own labs. Its directory returns 731 results spanning Core Faculty, Faculty Affiliates, Advisory/Steering committees, Fellows (multiple years), Leadership & Staff, and Postdocs/Visiting Scholars across every BU school -- far too large and multi-year to enumerate individually here. The Institute organizes several named centers/initiatives, each worth its own future targets.csv row: AI Research Initiative (see bu-hariri-air), AI and Education Initiative, Center for Computational Science, Center for Information & Systems Engineering (already recorded separately, bu-cise.json), Center for Reliable Information Systems and Cyber Security, Digital Health Initiative, Red Hat Collaboratory, Software & Application Innovation Lab (SAIL).
